title: SkillForge: Co-Evolving Skills and Agents via Dynamic Skill Lifecycles
title_zh: SkillForge:通过动态技能生命周期实现技能和代理的共同进化

paragraphs.en: Memory-augmented reinforcement learning strengthens LLM agents’ ability to solve complex long-horizon tasks. Skills are one such form of memory, pairing instructions with an applicability condition over task types. However, retaining every skill indiscriminately as the policy improves lets obsolete or harmful entries accumulate and mislead the agent. We propose SkillForge , an agentic RL method that compiles and evolves the skill library through a fitness-driven skill lifecycle of trial , active , stable , and retired states, so that the skills and the model co-evolve throughout training. A pre-RL evaluation phase first uses the base model’s own rollouts to pre-retire low-fitness skills, yielding a filtered library that then seeds supervised fine-tuning. Reinforcement learning takes over from this checkpoint, and at each iteration selective retirement, stabilization, and LLM-guided mutation continue to forge the skill library alongside policy optimization. Across multiple interactive agent benchmarks, SkillForge achieves the highest aggregate success rate, delivering up to 7.8% relative improvement over the strongest baseline while keeping the skill library compact throughout training. We introduce SkillFurnace , a dataset of 5k+ annotated records bundling retirement-filtered SFT trajectories, evolved skill libraries with fitness annotations, and retirement events with human-annotated failure categories to support research on skill quality and lifecycle management.
paragraphs.zh: 增强记忆的重强化学习提升了大型语言模型智能体解决复杂长期任务的能力。 技能是这种记忆形式之一，它将指令与适用于特定任务类型的条件相结合。 然而，随着策略的改进，不加区分地保留所有技能会导致过时或有害的技能条目不断积累，从而误导智能体。 我们提出了 SkillForge——一种智能体强化学习方法，它通过由适应性驱动的技能生命周期（包括试验、活跃、稳定和退役状态）来编译和演化技能库，使技能和模型在整个训练过程中协同进化。 在强化学习之前的评估阶段，首先利用基础模型自身的推理结果提前淘汰低适应性的技能，从而生成一个经过筛选的库，该库随后用于监督微调的初始化。 从这一检查点开始，强化学习接管后续过程；在每次迭代中，选择性地淘汰、稳定和由大型语言模型引导的变异操作会持续塑造技能库，并与策略优化同步进行。 在多个交互式智能体基准测试中，SkillForge 实现了最高的综合成功率，相较于最强的基线模型提升了高达 7.8%，同时在整个训练过程中保持了技能库的紧凑性。 我们引入了 SkillFurnace——一个包含 5000 多条标注记录的数据集，整合了经过淘汰筛选的监督微调轨迹、带有适应性标注的演化技能库，以及由人类标注失败类别的淘汰事件，以支持对技能质量和生命周期管理的研究。

paragraphs.en: Generalist agents such as Claude Code ( Anthropic, 2025 ) and OpenClaw ( OpenClaw, 2026 ) derive much of their capability from modular, reusable abstractions provided at inference time. Even frontier large language models (LLMs) sit behind a fixed knowledge cutoff, so they cannot absorb personalized workflows ( Chhikara et al., 2025 ) or adapt to post-deployment tooling conventions ( Liu et al., 2025 ) . To close this gap at inference time, recent work centers on the skill : a bundle of instructions, examples, and applicability conditions retrieved into the agent’s context on demand. Skill libraries are assembled from procedural memory combining step-level and script-level abstractions ( Fang et al., 2025 ) , or through autonomous skill-discovery loops ( Yang et al., 2025 ) . As libraries grow, however, retrieval-based augmentation degrades: top- k k retrieval returns noisier context, outdated skills crowd out high-quality ones, and many entries no longer match the agent’s current capability. Li et al. (2026a) confirm these risks empirically: curated libraries contain skills that hurt performance, and larger libraries yield diminishing returns.
paragraphs.zh: 像 Claude Code（Anthropic，2025）和 OpenClaw（OpenClaw，2026）这样的通用型智能体，其能力的很大一部分源于推理时提供的模块化、可重用的抽象模块。即便是前沿的大语言模型（LLM），也存在固定的知识截止日，因此它们无法吸收个性化的工作流程（Chhikara 等人，2025），也无法适应部署后的工具使用规范（Liu 等人，2025）。为了在推理阶段弥合这一差距，近期的研究将重点放在了“技能”上：技能是一组指令、示例和适用性条件的集合，可根据需求检索并纳入智能体的上下文。技能库可以通过结合步骤级和脚本级抽象模块的过程性记忆来构建（Fang 等人，2025），也可以通过自主的技能发现循环实现（Yang 等人，2025）。然而，随着技能库的规模扩大，基于检索的增强效果会逐渐下降：前 k 项检索会返回更嘈杂的上下文，过时的技能会挤占高质量技能的空间，许多条目也不再与智能体的当前能力相匹配。Li 等人（2026a）通过实证研究证实了这些风险：精心挑选的技能库中仍可能包含降低性能的技能，而规模更大的技能库带来的收益则逐渐递减。

paragraphs.en: A complementary line of work trains the policy via agentic reinforcement learning (Agentic RL) against environment reward. Pairing skills or other accumulated memory with RL is a natural combination: skills focus exploration with behavioral priors, while RL shapes the policy through interaction. Recent skill-augmented RL injects retrieved skills into the agent’s context each rollout ( Xia et al., 2026 ) ; related threads close an offline-to-online distillation loop ( Wu et al., 2025 ) or run policy updates directly over episodic memory ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) . Yet these methods all treat the library as append-only, leaving the agent’s context polluted by low-quality skills, bloated by unbounded accumulation, and misled by once-useful skills that turn counterproductive as the policy improves, a failure mode we call delayed obsolescence : a skill whose fitness once reached the stable state but later drops below the retirement threshold as the policy matures.
paragraphs.zh: 另一项互补的研究工作通过智能体强化学习（Agentic RL）结合环境奖励来训练策略。 将技能或其他积累的记忆与强化学习相结合是一种自然的组合：技能利用行为先验来引导探索，而强化学习则通过交互塑造策略。 近期的技能增强强化学习方法在每次执行过程中将检索到的技能注入智能体的上下文（Xia et al., 2026）；相关研究则实现了从离线到在线的蒸馏循环（Wu et al., 2025），或直接在情景记忆中执行策略更新（Zhang et al., 2026）。 然而，这些方法都将技能库视为只读追加结构，导致智能体的上下文被低质量技能污染、因无限制积累而臃肿，并可能被曾经有用但随策略改进而变得适得其反的技能误导。我们将这种失效模式称为“延迟过时”：即某项技能的适应性曾达到稳定状态，但随着策略成熟，其适应性后来降至退役阈值以下。

paragraphs.en: We propose SkillForge , which treats skill library management as an active forging process rather than passive accumulation. Starting from a seed skill library distilled from trajectories, as illustrated in Figure 1 , SkillForge runs in three stages: (i) pre-retire seed skills that fail under the base model’s own rollouts, (ii) cold-start fine-tuning on the surviving fitness-verified skills, and (iii) switch to RL training where skills and model co-evolve each iteration. Each cycle reads runtime fitness and moves every skill along the skill lifecycle trial , active , stable , retired , with borderline-fitness skills rewritten by an LLM-guided mutation operator. paragraphs.en: Early work took the form of in-context reflection: self-critiquing the current output ( Shinn et al., 2023 ; Madaan et al., 2023 ) , and subsequently mining cross-trajectory insights ( Majumder et al., 2023 ; Zhao et al., 2024 ) . In parallel, skill-library methods emerged: Wang et al. (2023) introduced an executable-code library for open-ended exploration, followed by reusable task workflows ( Wang et al., 2024 ) , and more recently procedural memory mixing step-level instructions with script-level abstractions ( Fang et al., 2025 ) . A related thread autonomously discovers new skills for the agent to practice ( Zhou et al., 2024 ; Yang et al., 2025 ) . On the RL side, memory-augmented methods couple such repositories to the training loop: earlier work used external memory to support tool-assisted planning ( Putta et al., 2024 ; Bai et al., 2024 ) , and later closed an offline-to-online loop between distillation and retrieval ( Wu et al., 2025 ) . Most recently, Xia et al. (2026) combined skill libraries with RL training, injecting retrieved skills into the context during each rollout. In all of them the repository is monotone: entries persist once added and cannot be corrected as the policy evolves. SkillForge instead treats the library as a dynamic population under fitness-driven selection, retiring low-fitness skills and reshaping borderline ones via LLM-guided mutation in step with the online RL optimizer.
paragraphs.zh: 早期的工作以“情境内反思”的形式出现：对当前输出进行自我批判（Shinn 等人，2023；Madaan 等人，2023），随后挖掘跨轨迹的洞见（Majumder 等人，2023；Zhao 等人，2024）。 与此同时，“技能库”方法也应运而生：Wang 等人 （2023）提出了一种用于开放式探索的可执行代码库，随后是可重用的任务工作流（Wang 等人，2024），而近期则将过程性记忆中的步骤级指令与脚本级抽象进行了融合（Fang 等人，2025）。 一个相关研究方向是自主发现智能体可练习的新技能（Zhou 等人，2024；Yang 等人，2025）。 在强化学习方面，增强记忆的方法将此类存储库与训练循环相结合：早期工作使用外部记忆来支持工具辅助规划（Putta 等人，2024；Bai 等人，2024），而后期研究则在蒸馏与检索之间建立了离线到在线的闭环（Wu 等人，2025）。 最近，Xia 等人 （2026）将技能库与强化学习训练相结合，在每次策略展开时将检索到的技能注入上下文。 在所有这些方法中，存储库都是单调的：一旦添加，条目就会永久保留，并且无法随着策略的演化而修正。 相比之下，SkillForge 将技能库视为一个受适应度驱动的选择机制所作用的动态种群，通过在线强化学习优化器同步进行 LLM 引导的变异操作，淘汰低适应度的技能，并重塑处于临界状态的技能。

sents.zh: 相比之下，SkillForge 将技能库视为一个受适应度驱动的选择机制所作用的动态种群，通过在线强化学习优化器同步进行 LLM 引导的变异操作，淘汰低适应度的技能，并重塑处于临界状态的技能。

paragraphs.en: Jaderberg et al. (2017) introduced population-based training, applying fitness-based selection and mutation over the hyperparameter schedules of concurrent workers. The same evaluate-select-mutate template has since been instantiated with LLMs: LLM-as-optimizer rewrites evolve a population of natural-language instructions against a fixed held-out metric ( Yang et al., 2023 ; Guo et al., 2025 ) , self-referential variants let instructions evolve each other ( Fernando et al., 2023 ) , and quality-diversity searches pair a pretrained LLM with an evaluator to discover diverse high-performing programs ( Bradley et al., 2023 ; Romera-Paredes et al., 2023 ) . These methods all optimize static text artifacts against a stationary held-out metric in an offline loop. SkillForge brings fitness-driven selection and mutation into LLM agentic reinforcement learning, where the evolving entities are skills that augment the agent’s context during interactive rollouts. Joint online training makes skill fitness inherently non-stationary, requiring a lifecycle that retires and reshapes skills as the policy evolves.
paragraphs.zh: Jaderberg 等人 (2017) 提出了基于种群的训练方法，对并行执行的工作者的超参数调度应用基于适应度的选择和变异。 此后，相同的“评估-选择-变异”模板已被应用于大型语言模型（LLM）：作为优化器的 LLM 重写方法通过一个固定的预留指标来演化自然语言指令的种群（Yang 等人，2023；Guo 等人，2025）；自参照变体则让指令相互演化（Fernando 等人，2023）；而质量-多样性搜索则将预训练的 LLM 与评估器结合，以发现多样化的高性能程序（Bradley 等人，2023；Romera-Paredes 等人，2023）。 这些方法都在离线循环中，针对一个固定的预留指标来优化静态文本产物。 SkillForge 将基于适应度的选择和变异引入 LLM 的智能体强化学习之中，其中演化的实体是技能，这些技能在交互式执行过程中会增强智能体的上下文。 联合在线训练使得技能适应度本质上是非平稳的，因此需要一个生命周期，随着策略的演化而淘汰和重塑技能。

paragraphs.en: Three interactive agent benchmarks are used: ALFWorld ( Shridhar et al., 2020 ) , WebShop ( Yao et al., 2022a ) , and Search-Augmented QA ( Jin et al., 2025 ) , with the Search-Augmented QA setting spanning NQ ( Kwiatkowski et al., 2019 ) , TriviaQA ( Joshi et al., 2017 ) , PopQA ( Mallen et al., 2023 ) , HotpotQA ( Yang et al., 2018 ) , 2WikiMultiHopQA ( Ho et al., 2020 ) , MuSiQue ( Trivedi et al., 2022 ) , and Bamboogle ( Press et al., 2023 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用了三种交互式智能体基准测试：ALFWorld（Shridhar 等人，2020）、WebShop（Yao 等人，2022a）以及搜索增强型问答（Search-Augmented QA，Jin 等人，2025）。其中，搜索增强型问答涵盖了 NQ（Kwiatkowski 等人，2019）、TriviaQA（Joshi 等人，2017）、PopQA（Mallen 等人，2023）、HotpotQA（Yang 等人，2018）、2WikiMultiHopQA（Ho 等人，2020）、MuSiQue（Trivedi 等人，2022）以及 Bamboogle（Press 等人，2023）。

paragraphs.en: Baselines fall into three categories. Context and memory methods rely on in-context reasoning or external experience without updating the policy: ReAct ( Yao et al., 2022b ) , Reflexion ( Shinn et al., 2023 ) , Mem0 ( Chhikara et al., 2025 ) , ExpeL ( Zhao et al., 2024 ) , MemP ( Fang et al., 2025 ) , and SimpleMem ( Liu et al., 2025 ) . RL-based methods optimize the policy via group-relative advantage estimation: RLOO ( Ahmadian et al., 2024 ) and GRPO ( Shao et al., 2024 ) . Memory-augmented RL methods couple persistent memory with policy optimization and form the most direct comparison: MemRL ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) , EvolveR ( Wu et al., 2025 ) , SkillRL ( Xia et al., 2026 ) , and two additional combinations, Mem0+GRPO and SimpleMem+GRPO, implemented by adding GRPO optimization to the respective memory mechanisms. For Search-Augmented QA the comparison additionally includes Search-o1 ( Li et al., 2025 ) , R1-Instruct ( Team, 2025a ) , Search-R1 ( Jin et al., 2025 ) , ZeroSearch ( Sun et al., 2025 ) , and StepSearch ( Zheng et al., 2025 ) . GPT-4o ( OpenAI, 2024 ) and Gemini-2.5-Pro ( Team, 2025b ) are reported as frontier reference points.
paragraphs.zh: 基线方法分为三类。 上下文与记忆方法依赖上下文推理或外部经验，而无需更新策略：ReAct（Yao 等，2022b）、Reflexion（Shinn 等，2023）、Mem0（Chhikara 等，2025）、ExpeL（Zhao 等，2024）、MemP（Fang 等，2025）和 SimpleMem（Liu 等，2025）。 基于强化学习的方法通过组相对优势估计来优化策略：RLOO（Ahmadian 等，2024）和 GRPO（Shao 等，2024）。 增强记忆的强化学习方法将持久记忆与策略优化相结合，构成了最直接的对比：MemRL（Zhang 等，2026）、EvolveR（Wu 等，2025）、SkillRL（Xia 等，2026），以及另外两种组合——Mem0+GRPO 和 SimpleMem+GRPO，它们通过将 GRPO 优化添加到相应的记忆机制中实现。 对于搜索增强型问答任务，对比还包含了 Search-o1（Li 等，2025）、R1-Instruct（Team，2025a）、Search-R1（Jin 等，2025）、ZeroSearch（Sun 等，2025）和 StepSearch（Zheng 等，2025）。 GPT-4o（OpenAI，2024）和 Gemini-2.5-Pro（Team，2025b）被报告为前沿参考点。

paragraphs.en: SkillForge treats skill-library management as a fitness-driven forging process in which skills and the model co-evolve under online RL through retirement, stabilization, and LLM-guided mutation, delivering up to 7.8% relative improvement over the strongest memory-augmented RL baseline across ALFWorld, WebShop, and Search-Augmented QA while keeping the active library compact. We release SkillFurnace , a 5k+ annotated record bundle of retirement-filtered SFT trajectories, evolved skill libraries with fitness annotations, and retirement events with human-annotated failure categories, in which procedural rigidity emerges as the dominant mode by which once-useful skills turn into active interference, the empirical signature of delayed obsolescence .
paragraphs.zh: SkillForge 将技能库管理视为一种以适应性为驱动力的锻造过程：在此过程中，技能与模型通过在线强化学习（RL）共同演化，包括技能的淘汰、稳定化以及由大型语言模型（LLM）引导的变异。在 ALFWorld、WebShop 和 Search-Augmented QA 任务中，该方法相较于最强的记忆增强型强化学习基线实现了高达 7.8% 的相对性能提升，同时保持了活跃技能库的紧凑性。 我们发布了 SkillFurnace——一个包含 5000 条以上标注记录的数据包，内容涵盖经过淘汰筛选的 SFT 轨迹、带有适应性标注的演化技能库，以及由人工标注失败类别的淘汰事件。研究中发现，程序刚性已成为曾经有用技能转变为主动干扰的主要机制，这也是延迟过时现象的经验性标志。

paragraphs.en: Table 6 lists all forging-specific hyperparameters. The pre-retirement threshold δ pre = 0.3 \delta_{\text{pre}}=0.3 is looser than the runtime δ retire = 0.4 \delta_{\text{retire}}=0.4 because the pre-retirement phase uses the unadapted base policy π θ 0 \pi_{\theta_{0}} , whose success rates are systematically lower than those observed during RL; a lower bar avoids discarding borderline-but-potentially-useful skills before RL has had a chance to re-evaluate them. Two usage-count thresholds also deserve clarification. The proto-fitness minimum N min = 3 N_{\text{min}}=3 (Eq. ( 3 )) is smaller than the runtime warm-up N warm = 5 N_{\text{warm}}=5 (Eq. ( 6 )) because proto-fitness is estimated under the fixed base policy over M M dedicated rollouts, so three observations already yield a low-variance estimate for the binary filter f ^ i < δ pre \hat{f}_{i}<\delta_{\text{pre}} . Runtime fitness, in contrast, is estimated under a moving policy and feeds into continuous lifecycle transitions (promotion, stabilization, demotion, retirement), which justifies a slightly more conservative warm-up. Correspondingly, Eq. ( 3 ) is a hard filter : skills without U i ( 0 ) ≥ N min U_{i}^{(0)}\geq N_{\text{min}} are simply not candidates for removal and remain in 𝒮 ( 0 ) \mathcal{S}^{(0)} . In contrast, Eq. ( 6 ) must emit a numeric score for retrieval and ranking, so it falls back to the neutral prior f default = 0.5 f_{\text{default}}=0.5 when the usage count is too low to trust the empirical rate. A second boundary case arises because δ low = δ retire = 0.4 \delta_{\text{low}}=\delta_{\text{retire}}=0.4 : a skill with f i f_{i} exactly equal to this value satisfies both the retirement condition (strict inequality f i < δ retire f_{i}<\delta_{\text{retire}} is false, so retirement does not fire) and the mutation range (closed interval [ δ low , δ high ] [\delta_{\text{low}},\delta_{\text{high}}] includes the endpoint), so such a skill is eligible for mutation but not retirement and behaves identically to skills with f i f_{i} slightly above 0.4 0.4 .

paragraphs.en: SkillFurnace is a three-part dataset released alongside SkillForge . Each part draws from a distinct data source within our experimental pipeline: (i) SFT trajectories come from rollouts of the Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct base model during the preliminary evaluation phase, before any RL training has begun; (ii) evolved skill libraries are initialized from the seed library released by SkillRL [ Xia et al., 2026 ] and then logged at every forging cycle as one record per skill per snapshot; (iii) retirement events are lifecycle-gate decisions aggregated across the primary training run and additional previously recorded training runs (ablation variants and replicate seeds), so that the released event count is not limited to a single seed. Every mined event is labelled and quality-controlled under the same criteria as the primary run. In total, SkillFurnace contains 5,852 annotated records across the three environments: 1,013 SFT trajectories, 4,521 library snapshot records, and 318 retirement events, summarized in Table 1 . Table 8 summarizes the library component across environments, Table 1 reports dataset scale and retirement-event statistics, and Table 9 breaks retirement events down by failure category per environment.
paragraphs.zh: SkillFurnace 是一个与 SkillForge 一同发布的三部分数据集。 每个部分都源自我们实验流程中不同的数据源：(i) SFT 轨迹来自初步评估阶段 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 基础模型的推理过程，此时尚未开始任何强化学习训练；(ii) 演化技能库以 SkillRL [Xia et al., 2026] 发布的种子库初始化，随后在每个锻造周期中记录为每个快照中每项技能的单条记录；(iii) 退役事件是跨主要训练运行及先前记录的额外训练运行（消融变体和重复种子）汇总的生命周期决策，因此所发布的事件数量不会局限于单一种子。 所有挖掘出的事件均按照与主要运行相同的标准进行标注和质量控制。 总体而言，SkillFurnace 包含来自三个环境的 5,852 条标注记录：1,013 条 SFT 轨迹、4,521 条库快照记录以及 318 起退役事件，具体汇总于表 1。 表 8 总结了各环境中的库组件，表 1 报告了数据集规模与退役事件统计信息，而表 9 则按失败类别对各环境的退役事件进行了细分。

The initial library 𝒮 0 \mathcal{S}_{0} logged at snapshot 0 is the seed library released by SkillRL [ Xia et al., 2026 ] ; subsequent snapshots track how this seed evolves under RL. Forging runs every 10 training steps over the 200-step budget, producing 21 snapshots per run. Each snapshot emits one record per skill tracked at that step, yielding 1,512 records in ALFWorld, 1,683 in WebShop, and 1,326 in Search-Augmented QA, for a total of 4,521 library snapshot records. Table 8 reports the composition at the last training step. Across the three environments, the library grows from 44, 66, and 41 seed skills to a final non-retired size of 100, 95, and 85 at the cap S max S_{\text{max}} , with 132, 121, and 111 skills created cumulatively. Of the final non-retired skills, 76, 80, and 64 reach the stable state, and 57, 29, and 44 originate from LLM-guided mutation ( g i ≥ 1 g_{i}\geq 1 ), making 46.4% of final skills across the three environments children rather than seed skills. paragraphs.en: Each retirement event records the full autopsy of a retired skill: the skill content, the complete fitness history leading up to retirement, the lifecycle-transition log, parent and sibling skills from the mutation tree, a human-annotated failure category drawn from the 8-way taxonomy described in Appendix E.2 , and a free-text key flaw field describing the retired skill’s failure mode. To make the released sample size independent of any single seed or ablation setup, events are aggregated from the primary training run and additional previously recorded training runs; the per-environment totals in Table 1 therefore exceed the primary-run retirement counts reported in Section 5.4 by design. Retirement events exhibit an average peak fitness of 0.67 and an average lifespan of 38.0 training steps, with fitness dropping by 0.28 on average at retirement; 57.2% first reached the stable state before this decay, the defining pattern of delayed obsolescence that motivates the forging lifecycle. Figure 5 shows the lifespan distribution: retirements spread across the full training horizon rather than clustering at any single stage, so the retirement gate fires throughout RL rather than only at initialization or endgame. Table 9 reports the per-environment breakdown across the eight categories. Overly rigid ordering is the dominant mode in every environment (74.6% / 77.7% / 67.8%), confirming that procedural rigidity rather than content omission is the principal failure mode of LLM-distilled skills. Environment-specific patterns also emerge: hallucinated action accounts for 10.7% of WebShop events, corresponding to skills that reference UI elements absent from the WebShop environment, and contradicts environment is exclusive to Search-Augmented QA, corresponding to skills that invoke search operations the environment does not expose.
paragraphs.zh: 每次退休事件都会记录一个已退休技能的完整尸检报告：技能内容、导致其退休的完整健康状况历史、生命周期转换日志、来自突变树的父技能和兄弟技能、从附录 E.2 中描述的八分类法中提取的人类标注失败类别，以及一个自由文本的关键缺陷字段，用于描述该退休技能的失效模式。 为了使释放的样本规模不依赖于任何单一种子或消融设置，事件会从主训练运行和先前记录的其他训练运行中汇总；因此，表 1 中每个环境的总数在设计上超过了第 5.4 节报告的主运行退休次数。 退休事件的平均峰值健康状况为 0.67，平均寿命为 38.0 个训练步数，退休时健康状况平均下降 0.28；其中 57.2% 的事件在衰退前首次达到稳定状态，这是延迟淘汰的典型模式，也是锻造生命周期的设计动机。 图 5 展示了寿命分布：退休事件遍布整个训练周期，而非集中在任何单一阶段，因此退休门在整个强化学习过程中都会触发，而不仅仅是在初始化或游戏结束时。 表 9 报告了八个类别在每个环境中的具体分布情况。 过度僵化的排序是每种环境中的主要模式（74.6% / 77.7% / 67.8%），这证实了程序上的僵化而非内容缺失，才是 LLM 蒸馏技能的主要失效模式。 各环境特有的模式也显现出来：幻觉动作占 WebShop 事件的 10.7%，对应于引用了 WebShop 环境中不存在的 UI 元素的技能；而“与环境矛盾”则仅出现在搜索增强型问答中，对应于调用了环境未提供的搜索操作的技能。

paragraphs.en: As shown in Figure 6 , mutation lineages exhibit a heavy-tailed depth distribution: most refinements converge to a stable variant within one or two generations, while a tail extends up to nine generations when niches remain. paragraphs.en: As shown in Figure 7 , the 318 retirement events were labelled into one of eight failure categories. Two annotators labelled the events under this 8-way taxonomy; an initial pass reached Cohen’s κ = 0.5 \kappa=0.5 inter-annotator agreement, and remaining disagreements were resolved by discussion. The dominant failure mode is overly rigid ordering at 74.5%, where the skill imposes a fixed procedural sequence that fails for edge cases; the second most common is overly specific at 9.4%, where skills work for narrow task subsets but fail broadly. Only 10 of the 318 retirement events (3.1%) are labeled redundant with policy ; the remaining 96.9% contain prescriptions inconsistent with successful rollouts—rigid ordering, hallucinated operations, overfit specializations, self-contradictions—so delayed obsolescence reflects once-stable skills becoming concretely misleading, not the policy outgrowing harmless crutches. Environment-specific patterns also emerge: contradicts environment failures appear exclusively in Search-Augmented QA, where LLM-guided mutation hallucinates search operations absent from the environment.
paragraphs.zh: 如图 7 所示，318 个退出事件被标记为八种故障类别之一。 两名标注员根据这一八分类法对事件进行了标注；初步标注的标注员间一致性达到 Cohen’s κ = 0.5 \kappa=0.5，其余分歧通过讨论解决。 最主要的故障模式是过度僵化的排序，占比 74.5%，即技能强制施加了固定的流程顺序，但在边缘情况下会失效；第二常见的故障模式是过度具体化，占比 9.4%，即技能仅适用于狭窄的任务子集，但整体表现不佳。 在 318 个退出事件中，仅有 10 个（3.1%）被标记为与策略冗余；其余 96.9% 的事件包含与成功部署不一致的指令——如僵化的排序、虚构的操作、过度拟合的特化操作或自我矛盾——因此延迟失效反映的是曾经稳定的技能变得具体而具有误导性，而非策略本身超越了无害的辅助手段。 环境特定的模式也显现出来：与环境矛盾类故障仅出现在“搜索增强型问答”中，其中由 LLM 引导的变异会虚构出环境中并不存在的搜索操作。

sents.zh: 在 318 个退出事件中，仅有 10 个（3.1%）被标记为与策略冗余；其余 96.9% 的事件包含与成功部署不一致的指令——如僵化的排序、虚构的操作、过度拟合的特化操作或自我矛盾——因此延迟失效反映的是曾经稳定的技能变得具体而具有误导性，而非策略本身超越了无害的辅助手段。

sents.en: Environment-specific patterns also emerge: contradicts environment failures appear exclusively in Search-Augmented QA, where LLM-guided mutation hallucinates search operations absent from the environment.
sents.zh: 环境特定的模式也显现出来：与环境矛盾类故障仅出现在“搜索增强型问答”中，其中由 LLM 引导的变异会虚构出环境中并不存在的搜索操作。

When to apply : When evaluating candidate products against multi-attribute instructions. paragraphs.en: The successful child reaches stable status by maintaining high accuracy within its target niche; its aggregate fitness of 0.70 is below the parent’s 0.84 because the child targets a narrower set of tasks, but within-niche accuracy is what matters for the lifecycle, not aggregate fitness. The failed variant referenced interface elements such as “click on the Description tab,” which is absent from WebShop; its fitness decayed rapidly and the retirement gate filtered it out at step 78. The trial gate filters the hallucinated-interface variant before it affects the active library.
paragraphs.zh: 成功的孩子通过在目标细分领域内保持高准确性达到稳定状态；其综合适应度为 0.70，低于父母的 0.84，因为孩子针对的任务集更窄，但对于生命周期而言，重要的是细分领域内的准确性，而非综合适应度。 失败的变体引用了“点击描述选项卡”等界面元素，但 WebShop 中并不存在该选项卡；其适应度迅速下降，并在第 78 步被退出机制过滤掉。 试验机制会在幻觉界面变体影响活动库之前将其过滤掉。

paragraphs.en: The initial skill “Pick Before You Wander” produced two mutations with opposite outcomes:
paragraphs.zh: 初始技能“先拾取再漫游”产生了两种结果相反的突变：

paragraphs.en: Parent (“Pick Before You Wander”, gen=0, fitness=0.84): If the target object is visible or discovered, take it immediately; never leave it behind to explore other places.
paragraphs.zh: 父代（“先拾取，再探索”，gen=0，fitness=0.84）：如果目标物体可见或已被发现，则立即拾取；切勿为了探索其他地方而将其留下。

paragraphs.en: Successful child (“Verify, Grab, and Confirm Pickup”, gen=1, fitness=0.70, stable ): When a needed object is visible, move directly to it, take it immediately, and then verify it is now in your inventory before proceeding. → \rightarrow Adds a verification step that catches pickup failures.
paragraphs.zh: 成功的子智能体（“验证、抓取并确认拾取”，gen=1，fitness=0.70，稳定）：当所需物体可见时，直接移动到该物体处，立即将其拿起，然后在继续行动前验证其是否已存入你的物品栏。→ \rightarrow 增加了一个验证步骤，以应对拾取失败的情况。

paragraphs.en: Failed child (“Retrieve Target Before Locating Desklamp”, gen=1, fitness=0.24, retired at step 65): First locate and pick up the target object specified in the goal before navigating to any furniture. → \rightarrow Introduces a rigid ordering that fails for tasks where the lamp must be found first.
paragraphs.zh: 失败的孩子（“在定位台灯前获取目标”，gen=1，fitness=0.24，在第65步退出）：首先必须定位并拿起目标中指定的物体，然后再前往任何家具处。→ \rightarrow 这种严格的顺序要求在必须优先找到台灯的任务中会失败。

paragraphs.en: From the same parent, mutation produced both a beneficial specialization (adding a verification step) and a harmful over-specification (imposing a rigid task ordering). The retirement mechanism correctly identified and removed the harmful variant.
paragraphs.zh: 从同一个亲本出发，突变既产生了一种有益的专门化（增加一个验证步骤），也产生了一种有害的过度专门化（强制采用僵化的任务顺序）。 退休机制正确地识别并移除了有害的变体。

sents.zh: 退休机制正确地识别并移除了有害的变体。

paragraphs.en: A multi-generation forging chain on Search-Augmented QA:
paragraphs.zh: 基于搜索增强问答的多代锻造链：

paragraphs.en: Gen-0 : “Disambiguation Add-Ons” (fitness=0.88) If the name is ambiguous, append clarifiers (birth year, nationality, known work) to the query. ↓ \downarrow mutation Gen-1 : “Structured Query Escalation with Fallback” (fitness=0.21, retired at step 83) Systematically escalate through three reformulation strategies when initial results lack evidence. → \rightarrow Too rigid; forced 3-step escalation even for simple queries. ↓ \downarrow later mutation from same lineage Gen-1 : “Verify Before Acting” (fitness=0.70, stable ) Before performing any action on an entity, first confirm its identity by searching with disambiguating context. → \rightarrow Simpler, more general, and more effective.
paragraphs.zh: Gen-0：“消歧义附加组件”（适应度=0.88）如果名称存在歧义，则在查询后附加澄清信息（出生年份、国籍、已知作品）。↓ \downarrow 突变 Gen-1：“结构化查询升级与回退机制”（适应度=0.21，在第83步被淘汰）当初始结果缺乏证据时，系统性地通过三种重述策略进行升级。→ \rightarrow 过于僵化；即使是简单查询也被迫执行3步升级。↓ \downarrow 来自同一谱系的后续突变 Gen-1：“行动前验证”（适应度=0.70，稳定）在对某个实体执行任何操作之前，先通过搜索并加入消歧义上下文来确认其身份。→ \rightarrow 更简单、更通用且更有效。

paragraphs.en: Forging explores multiple directions from the same parent: the overly complex variant is retired while the simpler, more robust variant survives.
paragraphs.zh: 锻造会从同一个父节点出发探索多个方向：过于复杂的变体将被淘汰，而更简单、更稳健的变体则会保留下来。

paragraphs.en: This appendix elaborates on how the KL penalty in Eq. ( 1 ) composes with the evolving skill library, complementing the non-stationarity of the fitness estimator formalized in Eq. ( 11 ).
paragraphs.zh: 本附录详细阐述了公式（1）中的KL惩罚项如何与不断演化的技能库相互作用，从而补充了公式（11）中形式化的适应度估计器的非平稳性。

paragraphs.en: Under our formulation (Eq. ( 2 )), the library 𝒮 ( k ) \mathcal{S}^{(k)} enters the policy through the context p t p_{t} rather than through the policy parameters θ \theta . The parameterization of π θ \pi_{\theta} is therefore invariant across forging cycles; what varies over training is the prompt distribution fed to the fixed network. The KL term D KL ( π θ ∥ π ref ) D_{\text{KL}}(\pi_{\theta}\|\pi_{\text{ref}}) is always evaluated at the same context c n , l c_{n,l} seen by both π θ \pi_{\theta} and π ref \pi_{\text{ref}} , so the divergence is well-defined at every training step, regardless of how far 𝒮 ( k ) \mathcal{S}^{(k)} has drifted from 𝒮 ( 0 ) \mathcal{S}^{(0)} .
paragraphs.zh: 在我们的公式（方程 (2)）中，库 𝒮 ( k ) \mathcal{S}^{(k)} 通过上下文 p t p_{t} 进入策略，而不是通过策略参数 θ \theta 。因此，π θ \pi_{\theta} 的参数化在整个伪造周期中保持不变；在训练过程中发生变化的是输入到固定网络中的提示分布。KL 项 D KL ( π θ ∥ π ref ) D_{\text{KL}}(\pi_{\theta}\|\pi_{\text{ref}}) 始终在 π θ \pi_{\theta} 和 π ref \pi_{\text{ref}} 都观察到的相同上下文 c n , l c_{n,l} 处进行评估，因此无论 𝒮 ( k ) \mathcal{S}^{(k)} 与 𝒮 ( 0 ) \mathcal{S}^{(0)} 偏离了多远，该散度在每一步训练中都定义明确。

paragraphs.en: Two structural properties align the fixed anchor π ref \pi_{\text{ref}} with the library-conditioned inputs it encounters during RL. First, mutated skills are teacher-model rewrites of surviving parents that preserve the ( v , b , ω ) (v,b,\omega) schema of Section 3.2 , so new prompts differ from SFT-time prompts mainly in skill content rather than in structural form, on which π ref \pi_{\text{ref}} remains a calibrated next-token predictor. Second, we use β = 10 − 3 \beta=10^{-3} (Table 5 ), so the KL term acts as a soft regularizer against large single-step deviations rather than a tight anchor to the SFT policy’s full conditional distribution. An alternative design is to re-anchor π ref \pi_{\text{ref}} at each forging cycle, trading the clean separation between SFT initialization and RL optimization for tighter alignment between the reference policy and the current library; this variant is compatible with the rest of our framework, and the fixed-anchor choice is the simpler default we adopt here.
paragraphs.zh: 两个结构性特性使固定锚点 π ref \pi_{\text{ref}} 与其在强化学习（RL）过程中遇到的库条件输入保持一致。 首先，变异技能是教师模型对存活父代技能的改写，这些改写保留了第 3.2 节中的 ( v , b , ω ) (v,b,\omega) 模式，因此新提示与 SFT 阶段的提示主要区别在于技能内容，而非结构性形式；在结构性形式方面，π ref \pi_{\text{ref}} 仍然是一个经过校准的下一个词预测器。 其次，我们使用 β = 10 − 3 \beta=10^{-3}（表 5），因此 KL 项起到一种软正则化的作用，以防止单步出现较大偏差，而不是严格锚定到 SFT 策略的完整条件分布上。 另一种设计方法是在每个锻造周期中重新锚定 π ref \pi_{\text{ref}}，这种设计以牺牲 SFT 初始化和 RL 优化之间的清晰分离为代价，换取参考策略与当前库之间更紧密的对齐；该变体与我们框架的其他部分兼容，而固定锚点的选择则是我们在此采用的更简单的默认方案。

paragraphs.en: Fitness is defined at the episode level: the K K retrieved skills share a single binary reward (Eq. ( 6 )). This is an approximation—in episodes where multiple skills are co-retrieved, the signal cannot distinguish individual skill contributions. We mitigate this via applicability-conditioned retrieval, which spreads skills across task types; the top co-retrieval frequency across all skill pairs remains under 15 % 15\% of episodes in each environment, so in practice each skill’s fitness estimate is dominated by episodes where it was retrieved alone. Nevertheless, the shared-credit assumption may slow convergence on tasks where skill co-retrieval is structurally unavoidable.
paragraphs.zh: 适应度在回合层级上定义：检索到的 K 个技能共享一个二进制奖励（公式 (6)）。 这是一种近似——在多个技能被共同检索的回合中，该信号无法区分各个技能的贡献。 我们通过适用性条件检索来缓解这一问题，这种检索方式将技能分布到不同类型的任务中；在所有技能对中的最高共同检索频率在每个环境中均低于回合数的 15%（15\%），因此实际上每个技能的适应度估计主要由其单独被检索的回合决定。 尽管如此，在技能共同检索在结构上不可避免的任務中，共享信用的假设可能会减缓收敛速度。

paragraphs.en: All experiments use a 7B base model; lifecycle dynamics under larger models may differ, and we leave scalability to future work. LLM-guided mutation relies on an external teacher model ℳ T \mathcal{M}_{T} : performance is contingent on the teacher’s instruction-following ability. Any sufficiently capable instruction-tuned model can serve this role (Appendix B uses Kimi-K2.5 but imposes no dependence on a specific provider), but a weak teacher will produce low-quality mutations that the trial gate must filter.

paragraphs.en: Fitness is tracked as a cumulative running average (Eq. ( 6 )), which integrates evidence over the full lifecycle of each skill. This is the natural estimator for our detection target, skills whose accumulated success record needs to be distinguished from skills that were never effective; it is what makes “once stable, now failing” a well-defined pattern to catch. A faster estimator such as an exponential moving average would respond more quickly to fitness changes, but this sensitivity cuts both ways: a skill that encounters a transiently hard batch of tasks would be flagged before the policy has stabilized, producing false retirements. The cumulative average’s inertia is intentional—the lifecycle’s usage-count gates ( N retire N_{\text{retire}} , N stable N_{\text{stable}} ) already guard against premature decisions; within that framework, the cumulative estimate reliably separates skills with a strong historical record from those that have consistently underperformed. Table 1 reports an average retirement-event lifespan of 38.0 training steps, showing that retirement occurs promptly relative to the 200-step training budget despite the conservative estimator.
paragraphs.zh: 适应度被跟踪为一种累积运行平均值（公式 (6)），该值整合了每项技能在整个生命周期内的证据。对于我们的检测目标而言，这是一种自然的估计方法：我们需要将那些成功记录不断积累的技能，与那些从未有效过的技能区分开来；正是这种估计方式，使得“曾经稳定，如今失效”成为一个明确可识别的模式。像指数移动平均这样的更快估计方法虽然能更迅速地响应适应度的变化，但这种敏感性是一把双刃剑：如果某项技能遇到一批暂时困难的任务，它会在策略尚未稳定之前就被标记，从而产生误判的退役情况。累积平均值的惯性是有意设计的——生命周期中的使用次数阈值（N retire N_{\text{retire}}、N stable N_{\text{stable}}）已经防止了过早决策；在这一框架内，累积估计能够可靠地区分那些具有良好历史记录的技能与那些持续表现不佳的技能。表1报告的平均退役事件生命周期为38.0个训练步长，这表明尽管采用了保守的估计方法，但相对于200步的训练预算而言，退役过程仍然发生得相当迅速。

These numbers refer to | 𝒮 0 | \lvert\mathcal{S}_{0}\rvert , the distilled library before pre-retirement, to make cross-variant comparison direct. For − - forging the entire forging method, including pre-retirement, runtime retirement, and mutation, is disabled, so the SFT data is unfiltered and no skills are added or removed after initialization. For − - mutation, pre-retirement and runtime retirement both run, but the two mechanisms remove very few skills on these environments in practice: pre-retirement at δ pre = 0.3 \delta_{\text{pre}}=0.3 with N min = 3 N_{\text{min}}=3 discards only initial skills that demonstrably hurt the base-model policy, and on the three environments this is a small fraction of 𝒮 0 \mathcal{S}_{0} (typically 0–3 skills); the remaining skills then accumulate enough usage during RL to stay above δ retire \delta_{\text{retire}} , so runtime retirement triggers rarely when mutation is off and no low-fitness children are being introduced. Size changes driven by the lifecycle therefore manifest primarily once mutation is re-enabled, which is consistent with the joint role of mutation and retirement reported in Section 5.3 . The − - pre-retirement variant confirms this picture from the opposite direction: with runtime retirement and mutation intact, the final library still settles at the cap (100, 95, 85) because the cap is the binding constraint once mutation is active. sents.zh: 在保守假设下，即 SkillRL 每个种子的方差与我们观察到的各环境标准差（分别为 0.5%、0.4% 和 0.3%）一致时，合并的韦尔奇 t 检验得出 t = 7.91（ALFWorld）、t = 22.51（WebShop）和 t = 10.03（搜索增强问答），所有三个环境的 p 值均小于 10⁻⁴，从而维持了原有结论。

paragraphs.en: Treating experience accumulation as a quality-control problem improves agent performance and yields interpretable artifacts: the SkillFurnace dataset enables follow-up research on skill quality prediction and failure-aware generation. The contributed collection contains only SFT trajectories, evolved skill libraries with fitness annotations, and retirement events with failure annotations, and introduces no risks beyond those inherent to LLM agents that act in interactive environments.
paragraphs.zh: 将经验积累视为质量控制问题，能够提升智能体的性能并产生可解释的产物：SkillFurnace 数据集为技能质量预测和故障感知生成方面的后续研究提供了可能。 此次贡献的数据集仅包含 SFT 轨迹、带有适应度标注的演化技能库以及带有故障标注的退出事件，且不会引入超出 LLM 智能体在交互式环境中运行时固有风险的额外风险。
